description: Reschedule or edit an event — change its title, description, start/end times, location, status, reminders, or metadata. Use this to move an appointment to a new time or update its details. Provide only the fields you want to change. Holds cannot be edited; confirm or release them instead. External iCal events are read-only. `calendar_id` is optional — if omitted it is resolved from the event.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event. An all-day event is stored as whole days (midnight UTC of its first day to midnight UTC after its last day); setting true on a timed event widens it to the day(s) it covers. Moving one bound snaps only that bound and keeps the other. When moving an all-day event with a non-UTC offset, also send all_day: true so the written date is kept.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID that owns the event. Optional — if omitted the calendar is resolved from the event.

description.description: New description, or null to clear it

recurrence_rule.description: Set/change the recurring series rule (RFC 5545 RRULE subset, full-series semantics), or null to make the event a one-off. Changing the rule, start_time or timezone keeps each cancelled occurrence on its local date; the response lists any that no longer match in droppedExdates.

reminders.description: Reminder offsets in minutes before start_time. Omit to leave unchanged, null to inherit the calendar default, [] for no reminders.

timezone.description: Set or change the IANA time zone the series repeats in (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"), or null for UTC. Validated together with recurrence_rule and start_time, so a UTC-stored series can move to local time in one call (e.g. timezone + BYDAY=TU).

name: update_event
